criteria.text: Cloudflare route apply never sends a DNS record comment exceeding 100 characters; ownership check, create/update selection, rollback deletion, and restore selection all use the identical derived marker.
Signed DesiredPublicRoutePlan.DNS.SourceCoordinate and the desired-state hash are unchanged by the marker fix.
With dns.enabled=false, signed dns/zone-create|policy-apply|record-set|drift-remediate return the config-needed error, not method-not-found; enabled behavior is unchanged.
dns.enabled=true with a filesystem backend fails config validation with an actionable message; it cannot reach startup health failure.

A compose-typed service deployed on an explicit Docker unit reconciles and observes without a runtime-type conflict; implicit placement uses the legacy resolver unchanged; transient unit-repo errors skip the cycle without auto-remediation.
